verdict.rationale: HubSpot's official MCP server explicitly grants read access to contacts, deals, and engagements, and its CRM APIs (contacts, custom objects, account info) plus connected-email logging supply the underlying data (open deals, emails, history) needed for such a brief; this directly supports an AI-native agent pulling account context via MCP or API before a meeting. However, there's no documented end-to-end 'account brief' workflow or example, no explicit deals/engagements API doc cited, and no independent/hands-on evidence the MCP server actually performs this compilation reliably. Missing for 10: a demonstrated brief-generation example, explicit deals/engagements endpoint docs, and third-party corroboration of MCP data-pull quality.
